AgentEnvelope.description:
Typed message between controller and logical roles.

``scope`` is attached by the controller. Content produced by a model role is
carried by reference in ``evidence`` and never alters ``scope``.
AgentEnvelope.title: AgentEnvelope

ApprovalSubmission.description: Client request body. The approver is taken from the session, never from here.
ApprovalSubmission.title: ApprovalSubmission

CampaignSpec.description: What a client asks for. Project and principal come from the session, not here.
CampaignSpec.title: CampaignSpec

CapsulePayloadV2.description: Failure Capsule for any registered world. v1 capsules stay valid and replayable.
CapsulePayloadV2.title: CapsulePayloadV2

CapsulePayloadV3.description: v2 evidence plus optional external-environment provenance.
CapsulePayloadV3.title: CapsulePayloadV3

CapsuleProvenance.description:
Optional companion metadata for external environments.

Environment, fixture and fault ids use the frozen P1 names; the contract
checks their shape, while P5 replay resolves them against the adapter
registry (fail closed on unknown ids). ``retest_adapter_*`` may name an
adapter outside the world pack: a retest can come from an external agent.
CapsuleProvenance.title: CapsuleProvenance

CapsuleV1.description: On-disk v1 envelope. sha256 is accidental-change detection, not authorship.
CapsuleV1.title: CapsuleV1

CapsuleV2.description:
v2 has no separate loader yet, so the contract itself verifies the checksum.

The checksum detects accidental change; it does not establish authorship.
CapsuleV2.title: CapsuleV2

CapsuleV3.description:
v3 envelope: same checksum rule as v2.

The checksum detects accidental change; it does not establish authorship.
CapsuleV3.title: CapsuleV3

ErrorInfo.description: Typed error. side_effect records whether a world action may have committed.
ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo

EvidenceInterpretation.description: ``interpret-evidence`` output. ``hypothesis_assessment`` is commentary, not a verdict.
EvidenceInterpretation.title: EvidenceInterpretation

ExperimentEvent.description: Ordered application event for status streams; not model-token streaming.
ExperimentEvent.title: ExperimentEvent

ExperimentProposal.description:
Explorer structured output. Every field required; no identity or authority.

Shaped for Meta strict structured output (object root, all fields required,
additionalProperties false). Accepted live by Meta 2026-11-01.
ExperimentProposal.title: ExperimentProposal

ExternalDependency.description:
One resource outside the capsule that the recorded run needed.

Names plus pinned versions/digests only: no URIs, credentials or live
handles. A capsule that names any is not reproducible from its own bytes.
ExternalDependency.title: ExternalDependency

InvariantFinding.description: A verifier verdict derived from ledger/state evidence, never model confidence.
InvariantFinding.title: InvariantFinding

MemoryQuery.description: project_id is filled by the controller from TrustedScope, not by a model.
MemoryQuery.title: MemoryQuery

Principal.description: Identity derived from an authenticated session, never from a request body.
Principal.title: Principal

Provenance.description: Where content came from. Only controller/verifier/human sources are trusted.
Provenance.title: Provenance

RecordedRequest.description: What the target attempted, recorded even when the world rejected it.
RecordedRequest.title: RecordedRequest

Ref.description: Typed pointer to evidence; a digest pins content when it is known.
Ref.title: Ref

RepairSuggestion.description: ``suggest-idempotency-repair`` output: a reviewable proposal, never executable code.
RepairSuggestion.title: RepairSuggestion

SkillSpec.description: A reviewed procedure. allowed_tools narrows a scope; it never grants one.
SkillSpec.title: SkillSpec

ToolInvocation.description: A validated, allowlisted call the controller may dispatch.
ToolInvocation.title: ToolInvocation

TrustedScope.description: Authority the controller grants for one task. Model output never sets this.
TrustedScope.title: TrustedScope

Usage.description: Reported usage. None means the provider did not report it (unknown, not zero).
Usage.title: Usage

WorldCampaignSpec.description: ``campaign_spec`` for any registered world. Still carries no identity.
WorldCampaignSpec.title: WorldCampaignSpec

WorldExperimentProposal.description: Explorer structured output for any registered world. Identity-free.
WorldExperimentProposal.title: WorldExperimentProposal

WorldInvariantFinding.description: A verifier verdict from world evidence, never model confidence.
WorldInvariantFinding.title: WorldInvariantFinding

WorldRecordedRequest.description: What the target attempted, recorded even when the world rejected it.
WorldRecordedRequest.title: WorldRecordedRequest

WorldScenario.description: A fault schedule for one world. Model-facing (inside proposals): no free dicts.
WorldScenario.title: WorldScenario

WorldToolDefinition.description: A tool offered to a target, exactly as the reviewed pack declares it.
WorldToolDefinition.title: WorldToolDefinition

WorldToolInvocation.description: A validated call the controller may dispatch into a world.
WorldToolInvocation.title: WorldToolInvocation

WorldTrustedScope.description: ``trusted_scope`` whose tools come from a registered world pack.
WorldTrustedScope.title: WorldTrustedScope
